reason: T-0272/T-0317 rounds 10-12: forcing --deterministic and/or CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG on the dual-IPAdapter+ControlNet profile graph (§24-e) reproducibly destroyed coherence -- 0/6 fresh seeds coherent under full --deterministic (round 10, horizontal-banding failure), 0/8 under CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG alone (round 11, circuit-abstraction failure). Restoring baseline (neither flag) did NOT reliably reproduce coherence either (round 12: 0/8 fresh seeds), but it is the only regime that has ever produced a coherent frame at all (attempt 39, round 6). Beyond 'does not actively make things worse': T-0322 measured on the live host on 2026-09-08 that baseline is byte-reproducible across a server restart on an ordinary (non-§24-e) recipe -- two separate server lifetimes, sha256 abe9f2e7a83c7261849ef7e7a9354e5b67200d54c524fe44211bf6e4c13822a4 both times. So choosing baseline does not sacrifice cross-restart reproducibility for a typical graph, as originally assumed; it only leaves the already-unsolved §24-e coherence problem to T-0327. Live regime restored to baseline for this reason. See docs/assets/evidence/T-0272/README.md rounds 9-12, docs/comfyui-setup.md#determinism, and tools/board/ops/comfyui/README.md.
cublasWorkspaceConfigNote: CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG is a launch-time environment variable, not a CLI argument -- it never appears in ComfyUI's /system_stats response, so this file's own 'deterministic' field (which checkComfyUiRegime.js verifies against argv) cannot cover it. Whoever changes the live regime must also update the matching env var in the launcher (tools/board/ops/comfyui/start-comfyui.bat) by hand; see docs/comfyui-setup.md#determinism for the verification gap this leaves.
